description: This Java class defines the ExistsNode class, representing a node in an abstract syntax tree (AST) for a predicate that checks for the existence of a property. It includes methods for construction, property access, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: ExistsNode
classes.description: Represents a predicate node for checking the existence of a property in an AST structure used for RQL predicates.

methods.name: ExistsNode
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new node with the specified property.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns the property name this node checks for existence.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing PredicateVisitor to process this node.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the property string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the property.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this node.
